window.cost_basis: Commitments in (start_day, end_day] at decision-day prices; applied the following day.
window.interpretation: Descriptive changes include delayed pre-window actions, not causal returns on in-window decisions.

financing.interpretation: Accrued financing fees, not payments or cash-solvency evidence; value adjustment is relative to the initial contract.

mechanical.cash_error_measure: relative to expected cash; absolute if expected cash is zero
mechanical.share_error_measure: daily maximum absolute error across all assets

limitations: Coverage gates and successful runs do not establish empirical validity or a policy ranking.
This benchmark deploys a separately trained conditional strategy after a frozen greedy baseline prefix; it is not from-zero online policy learning.
Cross-scenario pre-policy pairing requires the same independently trained baseline model SHA256, environment and switch calendar.
Observed private ledger rewards and unfinished liabilities are not lifetime profit or social welfare.

coverage.scope: Global and each observed size/policy-epoch group must pass in every validation world and pooled.
